app.title: ArtPipeline Studio
app.subtitle: KEYLE· Art Pipeline
form.subject: Description
form.enabledHint: If unchecked, you can still generate via right-click; category batch only includes enabled assets
form.basicTabDesc: Filename, size, notes, and generation model — controls how this asset joins batch runs.
form.categoryTabDesc: Paths, default checkpoint, and shared prompts — inherited defaults for assets in this category.
form.aiTabDesc: Powered by DeepSeek — write prompts, refine workflows, or configure multiple fields in one chat.
form.checkpointCloudHint: Cloud models use the cloud: prefix; selectable without ComfyUI online.
form.comfyUrlHint: Connect to ComfyUI, list local checkpoints, and submit ComfyUI jobs
form.promptSegmentsHint: (ComfyUI) Segments merge at generation. SDXL: G = prefix + subject + scene; L = subject + scene + light.
form.positivePrefixPlaceholder: Quality & style tags, e.g. masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, 8k, RAW photo
form.positiveSubjectPlaceholder: Main subject & foreground, e.g. vintage revolver on crushed burgundy velvet, bronze engravings, crimson cylinder glow, purple barrel smoke
form.positiveScenePlaceholder: Background & props; leave empty if not needed. e.g. antique roulette wheel, skull tarot cards, brass coins, dripping candles
form.positiveLightPlaceholder: Lighting, palette, materials, e.g. low-key chiaroscuro, dark maroon and purple palette, bokeh, hyperrealistic textures
form.positiveMergedPlaceholder: Shows merged text after you fill the four segments; or use AI Write prompts to generate all segments
form.negativePlaceholder: Avoid artifacts & wrong styles, e.g. cartoon, anime, blurry, watermark, bright background, text, signature
form.comfyTabDesc: Four-segment prompts and workflow JSON; generation mode selects text-to-image, img2img, or editing.
form.genModeTextToImageDesc: Generate from text only; no reference image.
form.genModeImageToImageDesc: Use a reference image; redraw from your prompt with adjustable strength.
form.genModeImageEditDesc: Edit an existing image (inbox first, else source) from your prompt.
form.refImagePlaceholder: Relative to ArtPipeline or absolute path
form.volcScaleHintI2i: Jimeng scale: higher = stronger prompt, less reference kept. Reference generate often uses 0.45–0.75.
form.volcScaleHintEdit: Jimeng scale: higher = bigger change. Inbox edits often use 0.35–0.55 to preserve layout and subject.
form.volcModeTextDesc: Prompt-only generation, no image input. Use output count for related image series.
form.volcModeI2iDesc: Primary reference (optional extras for fusion), prompt + scale. Writes to source and inbox.
form.volcModeEditDesc: Same API as Reference generate, but base is fixed to inbox work copy and output goes to inbox only (source untouched).
form.volcApiDetailText: POST images/generations · no image · sequential_image_generation: 1 = disabled; 2–15 = auto · optional negative_prompt, size
form.volcApiDetailI2i: POST images/generations · image: primary + optional extras (array, max 10) · scale · sequential_image_generation=disabled for single fusion/redraw · output count >1 switches to auto batch
form.volcApiDetailEdit: POST images/generations · image: inbox (fallback source) single file · scale · sequential_image_generation=disabled · same API as Reference generate; only base path and write target differ
form.volcTextHint: Output count >1 generates a related series; only the first image is saved (source + inbox).
form.volcI2iHint: Primary ref maps to image[0]; extras enable multi-image fusion—refer to “image 1/2” in prompt.
form.volcEditHint: Base file is the API image field; lower scale preserves more. Updates inbox only.
form.volcExtraRefsPlaceholder: One path per line (relative to ArtPipeline or absolute)
form.volcExtraRefsHint: Combined with primary ref into image array (max 10 total). Reference generate mode only.
form.volcOutputCountHintText: Maps to sequential_image_generation: 1 = disabled; 2–15 = auto batch (only first saved to asset).
form.volcOutputCountHintI2i: Usually 1 (single fusion/redraw). >1 switches API to auto batch; keep 1 for fusion.
form.volcOutputCountHintEdit: Editing is usually 1. >1 switches to auto and may not match single-image edit intent.
form.volcSizeHintTooSmall: Asset size {w}×{h} is below Jimeng API minimum (~{minSide}×{minSide}). Suggested: {sw}×{sh}. Adjust in Basic tab or confirm when saving the Jimeng model.
form.dashscopeModeTextDesc: Async text-to-image: messages with text only; parameters.size sets output.
form.dashscopeModeI2iDesc: Reference image + text in messages; no strength param. Writes source and inbox.
form.dashscopeModeEditDesc: Dedicated wanx2.1-imageedit model with function=description_edit; inbox only.
form.dashscopeApiDetailText: POST aigc/image-generation/generation · wan2.6-t2i · messages[text] · parameters.size / negative_prompt · async poll
form.dashscopeApiDetailI2i: POST aigc/multimodal-generation/generation · messages: image + text · parameters.size · no strength
form.dashscopeApiDetailEdit: POST aigc/image2image/image-synthesis · wanx2.1-imageedit · function=description_edit · base_image_url + prompt
form.dashscopeI2iHint: Reference sent as data URL in messages; no extra refs or strength slider.
form.dashscopeEditHint: Base is inbox (fallback source); edit API ignores cloud_strength.
form.tencentModeTextDesc: TokenHub Hunyuan 3.0: prompt + resolution, no reference image.
form.tencentModeI2iDesc: images[0] + strength; writes source and inbox.
form.tencentModeEditDesc: Same submit API with images, no strength; inbox base, inbox-only output.
form.tencentApiDetailText: POST api/image/submit · hy-image-v3.0 · prompt + resolution · poll api/image/query
form.tencentApiDetailEdit: POST api/image/submit · images[0]=inbox base · no strength field
form.tencentStrengthHint: Only Image-to-Image sends API strength; higher = more change. Edit omits it.
form.tencentI2iHint: Reference maps to payload.images[0] as data URL.
form.tencentEditHint: Base file is images[0]; no strength—describe edits in prompt.
form.stabilityModeTextDesc: Stable Image generate/core: prompt + aspect_ratio, no reference.
form.stabilityModeEditDesc: Same structure endpoint + inbox base; control_strength floor 0.55; inbox only.
form.stabilityApiDetailText: POST v2beta/stable-image/generate/core · multipart: prompt, aspect_ratio, negative_prompt, seed
form.stabilityApiDetailI2i: POST v2beta/stable-image/control/structure · image file + control_strength · aspect_ratio
form.stabilityApiDetailEdit: POST control/structure (current impl) · image=inbox · control_strength≥0.55 · not inpaint endpoint
form.stabilityStrengthHintI2i: Maps to control_strength (0.05–0.95); higher = stronger structure adherence.
form.stabilityStrengthHintEdit: Edit mode enforces control_strength≥0.55; higher = more change.
form.stabilityI2iHint: Upload PNG/JPEG as image; aspect ratio derived from asset dimensions.
form.stabilityEditHint: Inbox-first base; shares structure control API with I2I.
form.cloudStrengthHint: For Image-to-Image / Image Editing; higher = more change.
form.img2imgHint: Image-to-Image: uploads the reference to ComfyUI and redraws by denoise. Load an img2img workflow template.
form.redrawHint: Image Editing: uses inbox as base (source if no inbox); size follows base; output goes to inbox only. denoise ~0.35–0.55.
form.cloudPromptHint: Cloud APIs use a single prompt; no four-segment split or workflow JSON.
form.cloudApiSectionDesc: Connect third-party APIs alongside local ComfyUI models. Fill in keys and use Test connection to verify.
form.cloudMaxConcurrentHint: Max parallel cloud jobs; Hunyuan accounts may allow fewer (capped per provider).
form.workflowPresetIntro: Presets define how ComfyUI samples (single pass / dual CLIP / two-pass / img2img). Load, then save the workflow before generation.
form.settingsPathsDesc: Set your game project and ArtPipeline roots. Leave log directory empty for the system default.
form.settingsComfyDesc: Connect to local ComfyUI and set global sampling defaults (workflows may override).
form.settingsAiDesc: DeepSeek powers prompt writing, refinement, and workflow suggestions. Keys stay in local config only.
form.settingsFootHint: Click Save after changes. Paths and API keys are stored locally in pipeline_config.
form.logDirHint: Leave empty for system default ({path}); writes studio.log
ai.hint.prompt: Generate or rewrite prompts in four segments (prefix / subject / scene / light) plus subject
ai.hint.refine: Refine four-segment prompts; preserve unchanged segments when possible
ai.hint.workflow: Discuss ComfyUI workflow structure; writes JSON only when needed
ai.hint.basic: Fill or edit Basic Info: subject, filename, category, size, seed, enabled, remove-bg, checkpoint
ai.hint.category: Edit category shared prompts (positive_common / negative_common); applied to all assets in this category at generation
ai.hint.free: Default mode: configure basic info, category settings, prompts, gen mode, and workflow in one message
ai.placeholder.prompt: Describe the icon you want, e.g. a gambler avatar with golden lucky glow
ai.placeholder.refine: What to change, e.g. larger subject, remove white background, green poison FX
ai.placeholder.workflow: e.g. change sampler to euler, steps to 28, or which nodes to edit
ai.placeholder.basic: e.g. subject to "Luck dice · gold glow", size 128×128, enable asset, remove bg
ai.placeholder.category: e.g. write transparent-bg positive_common and negative_common for item icons
ai.placeholder.free: e.g. set subject and prompts for a luck dice icon, GII checkpoint, 128×128, enable remove-bg
ai.empty.prompt: Describe your asset; AI will draft ComfyUI prompts using category and size
ai.empty.refine: Tell AI what to adjust: composition, effects, negatives, description
ai.empty.workflow: Describe workflow changes; AI usually edits prompts unless you ask otherwise
ai.empty.basic: Describe basic info to write; AI saves to config (see Basic Info tab)
ai.empty.category: Describe shared category prompts; AI writes positive_common / negative_common (Category tab)
ai.empty.free: Describe what to configure; AI can fill Basic Info, Category, Prompts, and Workflow tabs at once
ai.selectAssetFirst: Select an asset on the left first
ai.failedClickHint: Click to restore the message in the input box
ai.composeHint: Enter send · Shift+Enter newline · chat kept per asset and mode
log.fabTitle: Drag to move · click to open logs
log.title: Run log
dlg.categoryCheckpointHint: ComfyUI checkpoint used as the default for assets in this category
dlg.noCheckpoints: No checkpoints found — check ComfyUI URL
dlg.importEmpty: No files selected. PNG / JPG / WebP — assets are created from filenames and copied to inbox
dlg.importHint: Images are saved as PNG to source and inbox; duplicates can be replaced and the old asset moves to trash
dlg.importHintRedraw: Redraw mode: images go to inbox only (source untouched); generation redraws into inbox
dlg.newAssetHint: Creates config only — does not call ComfyUI. Generate manually after filling prompts.
dlg.renameAssetHint: Renames existing PNG files in source, inbox, and Unity folders together
path.chip.inbox.ok: inbox · matches source (no post-process or restored)
path.chip.engine.outdated: engine · out of sync with inbox, re-export needed
path.notExistsYet: Path does not exist yet (may be created on save)
layer.subject: · subject
toast.invalidSize: Size must be an integer between 32 and 4096
toast.inboxFromSource: Inbox was empty — copied from source and ready to edit
toast.removeMagentaNoChange: No magenta pixels detected to remove
toast.apiRouteMissingRestart: API route not loaded — restart ArtPipeline Studio and try again
toast.apiPortalMissing: Official portal URL is not configured
toast.jobEndedCheckLogs: Task finished — check the log for details
toast.aiReplyOnly: AI replied; no config fields were changed
toast.aiPromptNotApplied: AI claimed to update prompts but nothing was saved; ensure checkpoint is a cloud model (e.g. Jimeng) or use Write prompts mode
confirm.renameOverwrite.title: Target filename already exists
confirm.renameOverwrite.message: "{name}" already has PNG files in source / inbox / engine (often left after deleting another asset). Overwrite and rename?
confirm.renameOverwrite.detailHint: Overwrite removes files at the target paths, then renames this asset's files to that name
confirm.importReplace.title: Import conflicts with existing assets
confirm.importReplace.detailTrash: Replacing moves the old asset's PNG files and workflow to ArtPipeline/trash and removes it from the list
confirm.volcSize.title: Jimeng size below API minimum
confirm.volcSize.message: Current size {w}×{h} ({pixels} px) is below Jimeng minimum ({minPixels} px, about {minSide}×{minSide}). Update asset config to {sw}×{sh}?
confirm.volcSize.detailApi: Jimeng requires the request size to meet the pixel floor; generation will use the updated asset dimensions.
confirm.volcSize.detailPersist: This writes to the asset config (width/height on the Basic tab).
confirm.deleteAsset.title: Delete asset
confirm.deleteAsset.detailConfig: Removes this asset's config and workflow references
confirm.deleteAsset.detailFiles: PNG files on disk will not be deleted
confirm.deleteAssets.title: Delete multiple assets
confirm.deleteAssets.message: Delete {n} selected assets? This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteAssets.detailConfig: Removes config and workflow references for these assets
confirm.deleteAssets.detailFiles: PNG files on disk are not deleted
confirm.moveAsset.title: Move to another category
confirm.moveAsset.detailWarning: Existing PNG files will be moved in source, inbox, and engine directories
confirm.moveAsset.detailCaution: Proceed with care: the operation is cancelled if a same-named file already exists at the destination
toast.assetDragHint: Drag to a category on the left to move
confirm.deleteCategory.title: Delete category
confirm.deleteCategory.detailConfig: Removes this category and all asset configs in it
confirm.deleteCategory.detailFiles: PNG files on disk will not be deleted
confirm.genCategory.title: Generate category
confirm.genCategory.message: Start generation for {n} enabled asset(s) in "{name}"?
confirm.genCategory.detailBatch: Assets are processed in queue order; track progress in the bottom-right panel
confirm.genCategoryExport.title: Generate & export category
confirm.genCategoryExport.message: Generate {n} enabled asset(s) in "{name}", then export to the game engine?
confirm.genCategoryExport.detailExport: After generation, inbox files are copied to the engine directory
confirm.genCategoryExport.detailBatch: Assets are processed in queue order; track progress in the bottom-right panel
confirm.exportCategory.title: Export category
confirm.exportCategory.message: Export {n} asset(s) in "{name}" from inbox to the game engine?
confirm.exportCategory.detailScope: Includes disabled assets; copies existing inbox files only (no regeneration)
confirm.exportCategory.detailBatch: Assets are processed in queue order; track progress in the bottom-right panel
pp.title: Post-process
pp.headDesc: Layer stack · inbox only · source is read-only
pp.cropHint: Rect viewport, matrix, or free crop · Enter confirm · Esc cancel
pp.cropTimeout: Timed out loading layer — check network and retry
pp.cropNeedImage: Select an unlocked image layer first
pp.cropModeEnter: Crop mode: drag a rectangle, Enter to confirm
pp.cropModeEnterSubject: Crop mode: subject layer can bake to master · Enter to confirm
pp.cropInvalidRegion: Drag a valid crop region first
pp.shortcuts: Del delete · M wand · RMB drag to pan · +/- zoom · Esc cancel · Ctrl+S save
pp.freeCropHelp: Drag a rectangle · Cut/paste create new layers (drag on canvas) · Del removes selected layer or clears selection · Enter confirm
pp.freeCropClipboardEmpty: Clipboard empty — copy or cut first
pp.freeCropCutLayer: Cut to new layer — drag on canvas
pp.freeCropPasteLayer: Pasted as new layer — drag on canvas
pp.cropHelp: Drag empty to create · drag inside to move · drag corner to resize · × at bottom-right closes · RMB drag to pan · +/- zoom · Enter confirm · Esc cancel · Shift square
pp.cropDragToSelect: Drag on canvas to create a crop selection
pp.matrixAutoStitchHint: When an entire row or column is marked removed, collapse the canvas
pp.matrixCropHelp: Add lines to split the grid · Click cells to mark removal · Click × at line end to delete · Drag lines to move · Del removes selected line · Esc cancel
pp.matrixCropNothing: Click cells to mark regions to remove
pp.name: Name
pp.canvasResizeLead: Change canvas size with live preview; saved when applying to inbox / source.
pp.canvasScaleContentHint: When off, only the canvas size changes; layer pixels and positions stay the same (may crop or add padding).
pp.blendLead: Keying permanently edits layer PNG alpha; tint blend affects preview only and can be toggled off.
pp.keyHint: Remove pixels near the key color across the full image (including lacunas). Use magenta preset for HudV8 assets.
pp.keyNoChange: No pixels matched the key color
pp.blendHint: Tint the layer and pick a blend mode for darken, lighten, and overlay effects.
pp.blendDisabledHint: When off, the layer renders normally without tint or blend.
pp.blendMode.normal.desc: Default compositing; keeps original color relationships.
pp.blendMode.multiply.desc: Darkens by multiplying with layers below; good for shadows and tinting.
pp.blendMode.screen.desc: Lightens layers below; good for highlights and glow.
pp.blendMode.overlay.desc: Boosts contrast while keeping lights and darks; good for texture.
pp.blendMode.soft_light.desc: Gently lightens or darkens with smooth transitions.
pp.blendMode.add.desc: Adds colors for brighter halos, highlights, and effects.
pp.blendMode.color.desc: Recolors the layer while preserving luminance detail.
pp.pivotHint: Pick a preset or fine-tune; pivot crosshair shows on canvas when this panel is open
pp.autoCropHint: Trim layer and canvas transparent padding, shrink canvas to content, and write back to the layer PNG.
pp.restoreSourceTitle: Overwrite inbox with source and reset layers
pp.canvasSizeHint: Apply writes the source PNG and updates the asset size in the list
pp.canvasSizeInvalid: Canvas width and height must be integers from 32 to 4096
pp.applyUnity: Apply and write to engine file
pp.exportLead: Export the current layer stack as PNG files (does not write inbox or engine paths).
pp.exportTightCrop: Crop each layer to tight bbox (offsets saved in manifest.json)
pp.smartSplitHint: Split by alpha-connected regions; supports transparent and solid-color sheets with auto background removal and grid projection. Hides the original subject layer after split.
pp.exportMultiLayers: Multi-layer export on apply to inbox (one PNG per layer in a subfolder)
pp.applyMultiLayersHint: Exports to a subfolder named after the asset inside inbox
pp.metaSourceEdit: {w}×{h} · {layers} layers · editing source {source} · canvas size applies on save to source
pp.metaUnityEdit: {w}×{h} · {layers} layers · editing engine file {unity} · transforms bake on apply
pp.confirmRestore:
Overwrite inbox with source and reset all post-process layers?

source is not modified; current inbox and edits will be lost.
pp.confirmEditSource:
You are editing the source master "{name}".

Changes write to source/ and sync to inbox for compositing. Continue?
pp.sourceChoiceTitle: Editing source directly is not recommended
pp.sourceChoiceMessage: Preview is set to source. Source is the AI master image; post-processing it permanently overwrites the file and cannot be restored with “Restore from source”.
pp.sourceChoiceDetailInbox: Recommended: edit inbox (working copy) instead — you can restore from source anytime
pp.sourceChoiceDetailRestore: If inbox is missing, a copy will be created from source automatically
pp.sourceChoiceDetailSource: Only choose source when you must change the master itself
pp.confirmOpenSourceEdit:
Preview is set to source.

Post-process will modify the source file directly. Changes cannot be undone (except from backup).

Open post-process anyway?
pp.confirmOpenUnityEdit:
Preview is set to the engine export file.

Post-process will modify that file directly. Changes cannot be undone.

Open post-process anyway?
pp.sourceEditWarning: Warning: editing source master directly. Pixel edits are irreversible. Layer settings save on Save / Apply to inbox.
pp.unityEditWarning: Warning: editing the engine export file directly. Pixel edits are irreversible.
pp.matteIntro: Edits layer PNG alpha locally. Border mode removes outer solid color; eraser removes connected same-color areas on click or drag. For full-image keying (e.g. magenta), use the Blend & tint panel.
pp.matteGlobalSameHint: Eraser only: click to sample a color and remove all similar pixels (incl. magenta in lacunas). Mutually exclusive with border matte; unchecked = connected flood from click only.
pp.matteGlobalDone: Same-color pixels removed globally (exit matte to save)
pp.soloHint: Show only the selected layer; hide others to inspect matte and alignment
pp.matteWandHint: Eraser mode: click or hold and drag to remove matching color; Esc to exit.
pp.matteModeBanner: Eraser matte · click or drag matching color
pp.matteBannerDrag: Drag to move · double-click to reset position
pp.matteModeHint: Eraser matte: local edits only — exit to save and continue editing
pp.matteMiss: Missed the layer — click or drag on the image
pp.matteExitSaved: Matte saved — you can continue editing
pp.matteBorderDone: Outer solid background removed (exit to save)
pp.historySnapshotFailed: Could not save undo snapshot; operation cancelled
docs.title: ArtPipeline Studio Docs
welcome.title: Welcome to ArtPipeline Studio
welcome.subtitle: Art asset pipeline · local & cloud generation in one place
welcome.feature1: Manage categories with source / inbox / Unity export paths
welcome.feature2: ComfyUI local SDXL or batch cloud APIs (Jimeng, Stability, etc.)
welcome.feature3: DeepSeek AI assistant for prompts and workflow suggestions
welcome.feature4: Post-process workspace and one-click export to your game project
welcome.keysIntro: Open the Settings tab and add keys (stored locally in pipeline_config.json):
welcome.keyDeepseek: DeepSeek API Key — powers the AI assistant
welcome.keyCloud: Cloud API keys — per provider used by assets (Jimeng / Stability / Tencent / DashScope, etc.)
welcome.keyComfy: ComfyUI URL — local generation requires a running server (default http://127.0.0.1:8188)
welcome.pathProject: Game project root — Unity project root for export targets
welcome.pathArt: ArtPipeline root — pipeline folder with source, inbox, workflows
welcome.pathLog: Log directory — optional; leave empty for the system default
